completed.summary: The static head made four false claims. Removed the fabricated aggregateRating (4.9 from 150 - LEGAL-002 removed the same fabrication from the runtime provider and missed this copy, the one crawlers read). Generated the 1200x630 og-image.png that og:image and twitter:image had pointed at since launch without either file existing. Repointed the Organization JSON-LD logo from the 404 /logo.png to /logos/logo.png and corrected its declared 512x512 to the real 2000x600. Dropped the SearchAction offering a sitelinks box at /search, which is not a route, and the msapplication-config pointing at a browserconfig.xml that does not exist. Separately, favicon.svg used React's stopColor instead of SVG's stop-color, so both gradients fell back to black - verified in Chromium, rgba(0,0,0,255) before, rgba(67,100,237,255) after. New guard: npm run check:seo-assets, CI-wired, zero-tolerance.

completed.element: the SEO surface now agrees with the coming-soon gate
completed.summary: Rendered the built app in Chromium and found the public site is behind App.tsx's COMING_SOON holding page (default ON - VITE_COMING_SOON must be 'false' to open it). The holding page sets noindex through usePageSeo, at RUNTIME, while the static head hardcoded index,follow - so every non-JS crawler was told to index 24 marketing URLs that all render the same page. A vite transformIndexHtml plugin now rewrites the robots meta from the same variable the gate reads, verified in both states. getSitemapRoutes takes the same flag: the sitemap dropped from 28 URLs to the 5 that actually render themselves while closed (signup, eula, privacy, terms, accessibility), which also corrects iteration 1 - it had published 24 URLs that serve a noindex page. COMING_SOON_ROUTES is asserted against App.tsx's Switch so the two cannot drift. robots.txt deliberately keeps no Disallow: / - a blocked crawler never sees the noindex.

candidatesForLaterIterations: Duplicate twitter tags: index.html uses property="twitter:*" (static, homepage copy), SEOProvider writes name="twitter:*" at runtime, so every page carries two conflicting sets
Duplicate JSON-LD entities: the static head ships Organization + WebSite and SEOProvider injects Organization + WebSite again on Organization-schema routes
The 'Application not configured' boot-failure screen renders a full head; under a missing VITE_SUPABASE_* it would be the indexable page if the site were open
SEOProvider sets article:modified_time to new Date() on every render - a freshness claim generated at page-view time, for content that did not change
Blog posts in seoConfig are hardcoded (3); dynamic blog posts from blog_posts never reach the sitemap
Canonical tags, hreflang, and trailing-slash consistency
supabase/functions/seo + RootAdminSEO / SEODashboard: verify the tenant-facing SEO tooling reads real data
structured data validation for the FAQPage / HowTo / SoftwareApplication schemas SEOProvider emits

sameAs in the Organization JSON-LD lists linkedin/twitter/youtube profiles nobody verified; a sameAs pointing at a 404 weakens entity resolution rather than helping it
